english: Place beside an end of the step deck, not on a step. You can register a second panel at the other end. Wire at least one to a generator or battery. Hold E for Start/Stop, Forward/Reverse, and Run Always or only when something is on it. Register it with the Escalator Setup Tool.
Not part of any escalator. Hold the Escalator Setup Tool, aim here, hold E, Register Panel.
Hold it, aim at a half-block step, hold E. New Escalator, Set End 1 and Set End 2 on opposite corners of the step deck, Register Panel. Sides you build stay put.
Craft the Escalator Setup Tool. Aim at a half-block step and hold E. New Escalator, Set End 1 and Set End 2 on opposite corners of the step deck only, then Register Panel.

You build the steps. Half-blocks only. Any width: mark opposite corners of the whole deck. Walkway: all the same height, at least 3 long. Escalator: two flats, then one half-step up each block, then two flats at the top. Leave the block under every step empty. Landings go outside the ends, as wide as the stairs.
Hold E on a registered Escalator Panel for Start/Stop, Forward/Reverse, and Run Always or only when something is on it. A tap of E does nothing.
Place the Escalator Panel beside an end, not on a step. Wire it to a generator or battery. Register it with the setup tool. The belt only runs when that panel is powered.
Stand on the moving steps and they carry you. At either end you step onto the landing. Anything on the belt rides — players, zombies, loot. Leave two blocks of air above the treads.
